'''92 ABY''' or '''92<ref name="Warfare" /> After the Battle of Yavin''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> In that year, the [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|MC140 ''Scythe''-class battlecruiser]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force|Defense Force]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] first debuted. The introduction of the ''Scythe''-class represented a clear shift from versatile [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] and massive [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] carriers to more specialized [[Warship/Legends|warships]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The year 92 ABY was referenced in [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.<ref name="Warfare" />
